senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; perh. a contr. of נעמלה, fr. עָמֵל)ant.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 63a:4">Ḥull. 63ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>כי הוה חזי נ׳ וכ׳</he> when he saw ants (at work), he used to say, ‘thy righteousness &c. (<cite ref="Psalms 36:7">Ps. XXXVI, 7</cite>).
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 5:2">Deut. R. s. 5</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 938:5">Yalk. Prov. 938</cite> <he>הנ׳ שלשה וכ׳</he> in the house of the ant there are three stories.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 938:5">Ib.</cite> <he>מעשה בנ׳ אחת וכ׳</he> once an ant dropped a grain of wheat &c.; a. e.—Pl. <he>נְמָלִים</he>, <he>נְמָלִין</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Peah 1:8">Tosef. ib. I, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 71b:6">Men. 71ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:2:4">Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᵇ</cite> <he>מביא נימולין</he>, v. <cite ref="N01325"><he>נָשַׁךְ</he></cite>.—[Chald. <cite ref="U00463"><he>שׁוּמְשְׁמָנָא</he></cite>.]
